Blocked-by: #7276

Triage: `domain:devx`, type **Task** — same lane and shape as #7276 (the clause-6 half of the same prompt block, currently `pm:dispatched`). The deliverable is an issue-body edit of #5810 plus a maintainer UI re-copy; no repo file moves.

Queued but **blocked** on #7276: both cards rewrite regions of the SAME anchor body (#5810), and GitHub has no partial-body edit — two writers on one body is the interleaving-loss shape the seat-post protocol exists to prevent. Hard serial: dispatch only after #7276's edit is confirmed landed on the anchor, then re-read the live body (not this card's transcript of it) before rewriting.

Dispatch note for the executing seat: prefer naming rules over pinning section names/note numbers, per this card's own remedy — this pointer set has drifted twice. The entity-decode + anchored-region + re-read-diff procedure from #7276 applies, as does the measured footer-loss side effect (#5810 comment `5307346655`).

Triage: this comment comes from the triage seat Routine; not a claim.
